survivingHypotheses.claim: Root cause class: effective per-request CPU ceiling is low (~Free 10ms / isolate flexibility), and rapid-fire Nelson commands routinely sit above it. Burst exhausts isolate flexibility → exceededCpu even when that request only shows ~17ms CPU; paced traffic stays under the effective ceiling (p50≈3ms) → 0×503.
evidence: Burst: CF outcome exceededCpu, exception "Worker exceeded CPU time limit.", Ray a1fe84df1a22a5eb-LHR, cpuTime=17, prior ok up to 64ms
Burst CF CPU p50≈15ms (above Free 10ms limit)
Paced 500ms: 270/270 HTTP 200, 0 exceededCpu, CF CPU p50≈3ms
CF docs: isolate flexibility for infrequent over-limit; consistent hits enforce configured limit
Repo docs reference Free-tier 10ms CPU budget: docs/operations/capacity-1000-learner-free-tier-budget.md

survivingHypotheses.claim: Nelson spelling command hot path is heavy enough (~15ms CF CPU in burst) to be incompatible with a 10ms-class ceiling once flexibility ends

rootCauseVerdict.statement: Root cause: Workers Free 10ms CPU/request ceiling interacting with Nelson spelling command cost under rapid successive submits. Burst exhausts isolate flexibility → Error 1102 exceededCpu. Not an app race, not projection_unavailable, not a single runaway request.
rootCauseVerdict.primaryConstraint: Cloudflare Workers Free: 10ms CPU time per HTTP request
rootCauseVerdict.triggerShape: Rapid sequential wrong→correct (and continue) commands without human pacing
nonTriggers: Demo/thin profiles under same burst (lower CPU)

lockedTheory.statement: On Workers Free, each request has a 10ms CPU budget. Nelson spelling commands in rapid burst typically consume ~15ms CF CPU (p50), so they rely on isolate flexibility. Sustained burst withdraws flexibility and Cloudflare returns exceededCpu/1102 even when the failing invocation only records ~17ms. Human-paced input keeps CF CPU p50≈3ms and stays under the 10ms ceiling.
